zh: 宾夕法尼亚州立大学（Pennsylvania State University，简称Penn State）成立于1855年，位于美国宾夕法尼亚州州学院市，是世界顶尖的公立研究型大学。学校在工程、农业科学、自然科学、社会科学、商学等领域享有盛誉，其学术研究水平位居世界前列。宾州州立大学以其优秀的教学质量和丰富的学术资源，培养了大量各领域的杰出人才。
en: Pennsylvania State University (Penn State), founded in 1855, is a world-leading public research university in State College, Pennsylvania. It excels in engineering, agricultural science, natural sciences, social sciences, business, and more, with world-leading academic research. Known for its excellent teaching quality and rich academic resources, Penn State has produced numerous talents across fields.
